findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: follow_funds · Private data: analyze_address, trace_transfer, find_token_insiders, scan_launch_tool, follow_funds, explain_transaction, get_connections, get_credits · Public sink: trace_transfer · Destructive: get_connections.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: follow_funds · Private data: analyze_address, trace_transfer, find_token_insiders, scan_launch_tool, follow_funds, explain_transaction, get_connections, get_credits · Public sink: trace_transfer · Destructive: get_connections

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_address" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
